description: This PHP file defines the DataRegistrationService class, which handles the registration of data with an external service through HTTP requests using GuzzleHttp. It includes methods to send registration data and manages an HTTP client instance.

classes.name: DataRegistrationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for sending registration data to an external URL using HTTP POST requests.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Injects and returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with the registration URL.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data via a POST request if the application is in production mode; logs errors if exceptions occur.
